description: Change the due date of the tasks listed by preview_task_move. Requires the preview token, the same task ids and the same date. A task moves only if it is exactly as it was in the preview; tasks edited, completed or already on that date since are left alone and reported. Applying again moves nothing more.

task_ids.description: Exactly the task ids listed in the preview, in any order.

to_date.description: The to_date returned by the preview, as YYYY-MM-DD.

name: apply_task_move
title: Move unfinished tasks
